tei:div.tei:p: nas chos thos pa don du mi gnyer ba dang*/ snod mi gtsang ba lta bu log par rtog pa'i sgo nas chos thos pa don ma yin pa dang*/ snod zhabs rdol lta ba'i sgo nas chos thos pa don med par 'gyur ba'o// //༈ dang po la gsum ste/ thog mar chos thos pa nyid du mi 'dod pa dang*/ 'dod kyang rab tu mi 'jug pa dang*/ 'jug kyang tha mar mi brtson pa'o/ /dang po ni

| gal te chos 'di khungs mi btsun pa'am/ brjod bya mi bden pa'am dgos pa med pas so snyam na/ ma yin te/ dam pa'i chos ni dang po sems bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags nas tha ma mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du rang gzhan gyi don mthar thug pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' dang dgra bcom pa rnams kyi zla la gzung nas gzhan don du mdzad pas bsdus shing*/ de'i dgongs pa mgon po byams pa la sogs pas bkrol te/ de dag skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyis phyin ci ma log par bsgyur nas/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyis gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de gsungs pa khungs btsun la brjod bya bden pa gnyis sam thabs shes rab zung 'brel ston cing*/ dgos pa gnas skabs lha mi dang mthar thug byang chub gsum thob pa yin no/ /shes ldan dag chos ni de ltar rang bzhin bzang po yin na cis mi 'dod ces bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa 'dod kyang mi 'jug pa la rgyu mtshan gsum las/ dang po chos bsgrub pa'i rgyu nyid med pas so snyam na ma yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ / rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes pas spyir sems thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi snying po yod pas/ rten shin tu dman pas kyang brtson 'grus bskyed na/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par nus pa'i phyir ro// //༈ gnyis pa ni rkyen ma 'tshogs te chos dka' ba dang blo zhan pas so snyam na ma yin te/ shes bya dang bsten par bya ba thams cad goms nas sla ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ goms nas sla bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /blo dang yon tan thams cad sbyangs pa las gong nas gong du khyad par du 'gyur te/ rnam nges las/ goms las khyad par 'gyur pa'i phyir/ /zhes so/ / sngan gyi skyes bu khyad par can rnams kyang bdag cag lta bu las mkhas par gyur pa yin te/ legs bshad rin po che'i gter las/ rang la dgos pa'i bstan bcos rnams/

/nyi ma re la tshig re bzung*/ /grog mkhar dang ni sbrang rtsi ltar/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen par 'gro/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni lang tsho yol te sgrub pa'i nus pa med pas so snyam na ma yin te/ khyim bdag dpal skyes kyi rnam par thar pa las zhan pa rnams kyis yun ring po'i don yang brtson 'grus dang ldan pa tsam gyis 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ bzhi brgya pa las/ de nyid goms pas skye ba 'dir/ /gal te grub par ma gyur kyang*/ /skye ba gzhan du 'bad med par/ /nges par 'grub 'gyur las bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /rin po che'i gter las/ rig pa nangs par 'chi yang slobs/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang*/ /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len dang 'dra/ /zhes pas 'dir ma grub kyang*/ tshe rabs gzhan du bde blag tu 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ / de lta bas na ci'i phyir mi 'jug ces bya'o/ ༈ /gsum pa 'jug kyang mi brtson pa ni | gal te chos ni de ltar bzang zhing bsgrub par nus kyang*/ me chu ltar rnyed par sla bas brtson 'grus bya mi dgos so snyam na/ ma yin te gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya lam ste/ /mi yi lus ni tshegs kyis rnyed par 'gyur/ /kye ma dad pa dang ni chos nyan pa/ /'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par dka'/ /zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /zhes pas/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba yin te/ yul mtha' 'khob dang*/ dus chos nub pa dang*/ gang zag dmyal ba la sogs pa thams cad la chos med pa'i phyir ro// gal te go lo byas nas chog go snyam na/ ma yin te/ bshes spring las/ tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi/ /chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /zhes pas thob pa'i dal ba yun ring du mi gnas pa yin te/ tshe thung ba dang dus mi sdod pa dang*/ rtsod pa la sogs pa'i bar chad mang ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na'ang tshe gzhan du bsgrub pas chog go snyam na/

ma yin te spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dge spyad skal ldan yang*// bdag gis dge ba ma spyad na/ /ngan 'gro rmongs shing sdug bsngal ba/ /de tshe bdag gis ci byar yod/ /ces pas tshe gzhan du sgrub pa'i skabs med pa yin te/ ngan song gsum du skyes na dad pa'i nyid dang rtogs pa dang bsgrub pa'i rten du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bas na shes ldan dag gis 'di 'dra'i dal ba thob pa chud mi gzon par pang du sbrul zhugs pa'am mgo la me shor ba lta bu'i brtson 'grus kyis mnyan par gyis shig 'gyod pa can du 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod par bya'o || || ༈ gnyi pa thos pa don ma yin par 'gyur ba la/ bsam sbyor 'bras bu don ma yin par 'gyur ba gsum las/ bsam pa ni khe dang grags pa dang pha rol gzhom pa'i bsam pa ngan pas nyan pa ste/ bsam pa des chos nyan pa'i sbyor ba thams cad nyes spyod du 'gyur ba'o/ /sbyor ba ni chos dang chos smra ba la log par bsgrub pa ste/ sems kyis ma mos pa ma dad pa dang*/ lus kyis mngon du phyag mi 'tshal/ spyod lam mi sdom pa dang*/ de dag gis rnam par smin pas ngan song du lhung ba dang*/ myong ba rgyu mthun tshe rabs thams cad du chos dang chos smra ba dang mi 'phrad pa dang*/ mthong chos tshe 'di nyid kyi bde ba las nyams par 'gyur ba ste/ yum rgyas pa las/ shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la chos spangs pa'i rnam par smin par ji tsam du 'gyur zhes zhus pas/ de'i lus kyi tshad ma gleng zhig ces gsungs nas ma gnang ba dang*/ yang zhus pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten re rer bskal pa dpag tu med par dmyal bar 'tshed pa dang*/ de nas phyogs bcu'i yi dwags dang dud 'gror skye zhing tha na mir skyes na yang 'on pa dang lkugs pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig yang yang sdig grogs bsten pas sangs rgyas ngan sems ldan gyur dang*/ / pha ma dgra bcom gsod pa bya ba min byed mchog tshogs 'byed pa'i mi/

/de yang chos nyid nges par bsam pas myur du de las thar 'gyur gyi/ /gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ /ces so/ /'bras bu las don ma yin pa ni nyan pa'i yon tan gyis sems khengs shing sgrub pa mi byed par snyan pa dang rnyed pa 'tshol ba'o/ /gsum pa mnyan pa don med pa ni blo'i mthu nyid med pa'am yod kyang bying ba'i rnam par g.yeng bas dang po thos pa'i don mi shes pa dang | shes kyang bar du le lo che ste bsam pas yang yang mi skyong ba dang*/ bskyangs kyang tha ma bya byed sna tshogs kyis sbyor ba mi 'grub pa yin pas/ khyod kyis de ltar mi 'gyur bar gyis shig ces brjod do/ /gsum pa bshad thabs kyi yan lag la bzhi ste/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ngos gzung ba dang*/ bshad pa 'byung ba'i rgyu dang*/ bshad bya sgra'i ngo bo dang*/ 'chad par byed pa'i thabs kyi man ngag go/ //༈ dang po ni bye brag gzhung 'di dang 'di yin no/ /zhes dmigs kyis bkar te gzhung de mdzad pa po'i khyad par dang*/ ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin la mtshan gyi don dang*/ gzhung gi tshad dang | phyogs gang du gtogs pa bsam pa rnams skabs dang sbyar te bshad do/ / ༈ gnyis pa la gsum las don gyi rgyu ni/ snga mar sbyangs shing 'dir brtson 'grus kyis mkhas pa'i gsung sgros thos pa dang*/ rtogs pa yod pa'am thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab las te/ rgyan las/ sems dpa' mchog gi ston pa ni | | chos mchog man chad/ lung dang rtogs sa bdun pa man chad/ dang dbang sa brgyad pa yan chad| 'byor las sa'i rton pa/ kha dang gzugs dang thams cad dang*/ /nam mkha' las kyang 'byung ba yin/ /zhes so// //༈ gnyis pa sgra'i rgyu ni khog pa la sogs pa sgra 'byung ba'i gnas brgyad bzang ba ste/ yi ge'i mdo las/ khog pa mgrin pa rkan dang lce/ /so dang spyi bo sna dang mchu/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i brtson 'grus ni sems can thams cad bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rjes chos 'chad pa la spro dga' dang bcas pa ste/

spyod 'jug las/ brtson gang dge la spro ba'o/ / zhes so// //༈ gsum pa sgra'i ngo bo ni/ brda' dag pa yul skad ngan pa spangs pa ste/ dang*/ gaṅgā'i chu rgyun ltar ngag 'brel ba dang*/ tshangs pa ltar/ dbyangs snyan pa'o/ /rgyan las/ rgyal sras tshig ni mi zhan pa/ /snyan gyis legs bshad grags pa dang*/ /ci rigs pa dang zang zing med/ /ran cing de bzhin yangs pa yin/ /zhes so/ / bzhi pa man ngag la gsum ste/ brjod bya'i don bstan pa dang*/ rjod par byed pa'i gzhung bshad pa dang*/ brgal lan gyis gtan la dbab pa'o// //༈ dang po ni don gyi dngos po dgod pa dang*/ dkyus kyi sa bcad pa dang*/ 'di man chad kyi don zhes/ 'og nas rdzogs pa'i ngag bsdams pa gsum mam/ yang na de yan chad bshad zin nas da 'di nas 'chad ces gang las 'ongs pa'i 'brel dang | dgos pa 'di yi don zhes gang gi phyir bkod pa'i dgos pa dang*/ gtso bo'i brjod bya 'di yin zhes gang brjod bya ngos gzung ba'o// //༈ gnyis pa ni ji tsam 'chad pa'i gzhung nyid bstan pa dang*/ them sbyor gyi sgo nas khyad par gyi gzhi btul bas ngag don blangs te dogs spong gi sgo nas khyad par gyi chos bshad pa dang*/ ngag tshig gnyis kyi dngos shugs la brjod bya ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul lo// //༈ gsum pa ni gzhung snga ma dang zlos pa dang*/ lung gzhan dang*/ khas blangs dang*/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba dang ma 'brel lo/ /yang zhes bsam pa ma rtogs pa'i rgol ba 'god pa dang*/ brjod bya dang dgos pa dang brjod tshul tha dad pas mi zlos shing 'gal ba dang ma 'brel ba med do/ /zhes rang gi bsams pa gsal por ston pa'i lan gtab pa dang*/ lung rigs kyi shes byed dgod pa'o | | yang na 'chad pa'i man ngag rnam bshad rig pa las/ dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*/ /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyor dang*/ /brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya/ /zhes pas don lngar yang blta'o/ /bzhi pa bshad pa la 'jug pa'i tshul la bzhi ste/

gdul bya'i dbang gis bsdus 'bring rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ dgos pa'i dbang gis mtshan nyid gtan la dbab bya'am bsgrub pa nyams len du bshad pa dang*/ 'brel ba'i dbang gis dgag bsgrub nyes spong du bshad pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i dbang gis sbyor dngos rjes gsum du bshad pa'o// //༈ dang po ni ston pas rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa lta bu ste/ rgyan las/ bstan dang rnam 'byed the tshom gcod/ /lan mang byed dang ldan pa ni// mgo smos rnam spros go rnams la/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni bstan bcos kha cig las gnyis ka 'byung la kha cig las gang rung re 'byung ngo*// //༈ gsum pa ni gzu bo'i blos dpyad nas gzhan gyis nyes bshad dgag pa dang*/ rang gi bshad pa dgod pa dang*/ de la gzhan gyis rtsod pa spang ba'o/ / mdo las/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /yongs su brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yi gus phyir min | | zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' zhig 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang zhig de mi dkrug /thub tshul gzhig phyir de ni dam chos la yang gnod pa byed par 'gyur | | zhes so/ /bzhi pa la gsum las/ sbyor ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdo las | dul ba dang ni zhi ba dang*/ /grol bas grong du zhugs nas kyang*/ /sems can gang dag chos 'tshol ba/ /de la bdag cag chos ston to/ /zhes gdul bya dad pa'i phyir/ lus ngag gi spyod lam zhi zhing dul bar bya ba dang*/ bshad pa mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir dkon mchog mchod cing gzungs sngags byin rlabs can gdon pa dang*/ lo tsā ba gtsug tor dri med 'don skad/ mthar thug byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ sgo gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs nas chos kyi rgyal po bdag seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i nga rgyal bya ste/

mnyen pa dang 'jam pa dang snyan pa dang*/ yid du 'ong ba la sogs pa gsung yan lag drug cus gdul bya dang 'tshams pa'i chos sna tshogs 'byung bar bsam mo/ /dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan du bya ba ste | dpe mkhyud med par ston pa dang*/ sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod sdom pa dang*/ dka' spyad bzod pa dang*/ chos 'chad pa la spro ba dang*/ sems ma yengs pa dang | tshig don la dpyod cing 'chad pa'o/ /rjes nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang | dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ stong pa'i rgyas gdab pa'o// //༈ gnyis pa mnyan pa'i tshul gsum ste/ nyan pa po'i khyad par dang*/ gang gis mnyan thabs kyi yan lag dang*/ ji ltar mnyan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni bzhi rgya pa las/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar brjod/ /ces pas rtogs par nus pa'i blo gros dang*/ ci nas shes par bya dgos snyam pa'i don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang*/ chos ston pa la nga rgyal lam g.yo sgyu med pa'i gus pa dang*/ chos nas ji ltar byung ba bzhin du bya dgos snyam ste bsgrub par 'dod pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa bzhi nges par dgos te/ gzhan du na nyan pa'i bsod nams tsam 'byung gi shes pa dang byed pa mi 'byung bas so// gnyis pa nyan thabs la gsum ste/ chos dang ston pa la gus par bya ba dang*/ gus par byas nas chos ji ltar nyan pa dang*/ nyan nas thos pa chud mi za bar bya ba'o//dang po ni lus dang srog la mi blta bar chos 'tshol ba rtag tu ngu lta bu dang*/ thos pas chog mi shes pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang lta bu dang*/ bla ma gus pa byed pa khye'u dpal 'byung gi bsten pa'i tshul lta bu'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ tha ma zang zing gi bsnyen bkur dang*/ 'bring lus ngag gi rim gro dang*/ rab sgrub par byed pa ste sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas so// ༈ gnyis pa ston pa la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bzhag ste des gsungs pa'i chos de shes par byas la de bdag nyid bsgrub cing*/

gzhan la bstan snyam pa'i bsam pas nyan pa'am/ yang na mdo phal po che las/ chos smra ba la sman pa dang | chos la sman dang*/ rang la nad pa dang*/ nyams su len pa la nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bzhis nyan par gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bla ma bzhugs sar phyin te mthun rkyen bsgrub pa sbyor ba thos pa'i rkyen bstan pa dang*/ dngos gzhi kun shes pa'i bsam pa dang rna gtad de dang yid btad de dang*/ slar bkug ste nyan pa dang*/ rjes lta ba dang*/ sems sgom pa la saugs pa nan tan phun sum tshogs pas bskyangs te/ khyim bdag dpal skyes kyi mdo las/ mkhas pa rnams la brten pa chud mi za/ /'phags pa'i tshul gyis legs bshad chud mi za/ / zhes so// //༈ gsum pa ji ltar nyan tshul la sbyor dngos rjes las/ sbyor ba gus pa'i spyod lam dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ dga' ba sgom pa'o/ /dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan du nyan te/ gdan dang me tog 'bul ba dang*/ sgo gsum sdom pa dang*/ gnod pa bzod pa dang*/ nyan pa la spro ba dang*/ 'chad pa'i sgra la sems rtse gcig pa dang*/ tshig 'dzin pa'i don dpyod pa'o/ /rjes nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba dang gtang rag gi phyag bya'o/ / gsum pa bshad nyan byas pa'i 'bras bu la gsum ste/ bshad pa'i 'bras bu dang

| nyan pa'i 'bras bu dang*/ des skabs don la sbyar ba'o// //༈ dang po la gsum ste/ spyir chos bshad pa'i dang*/ thar pa cha mthun gyi dang | bye brag tu theg chen gyi chos bshad pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni ting ngi 'dzin gyi rgyal po las/ /su dag ser sna med par ni/ /chos kyi sbyin pa mchog sbyin pa/ /de yi phan yon rnam bcu ni/ /'jig rten mgon pos rab tu bshad/ / ces pa dang*/ mig ldan mar me yod gyur na/ /gzugs rnams mthong ba ji lta bar | | de ni dge dang mi dge'i chos/ /thos pas rnam par shes par 'gyur/ / zhes so// //༈ gnyis pa ni byams pa seng ge sgras zhus pa'i mdo las/ stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di gser dag gis/ /yongs su bkang ste gzhan la byin pa bas | | tshig bzhi tshigs su bcad pa gcig brjod pa'i/ /chos kyi sbyin pa rab mchog khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pas zang zing gi sbyin pa bas mchog tu gyur pa dang | phan 'dogs byed par 'dod pa dang*/ gang gis gang gā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing*/ /rin chen bdun gyis yongs su bkang byas nas/ /ston pa rnams la mchod pa byas pa bas/ /'gro la chos ston mchod pa khyad par 'phags//zhes pas ston pa la mchod pa bla na med par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa/ sdud pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig shes rab mchog bsgoms te// de las langs nas gos pa med pa'i chos brjod cing*/ de yang 'gro ba'i don du byang chub rgyur bsngo na/ /dge ba de dang mnyam pa 'jig rten gsum na med// ces pa la sogs pa gsungs mod kyi mdor bsdus na gsum ste/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu gzhan gyis ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa dang*/ rang gis rtogs pa sbyong ba dang | thun mong du bstan pa gnas par byed pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu rtag tu skye ba dran zhing chos kyi bsgom pa'i tshul shes/ myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gzhan la chos ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang*/

mthar gyis chos kyi rgyal po nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa nyan pa'i 'bras bu ni mdo las/ ma thos pa las shes mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ thos nyung dmus long bsgom pa'i tshul mi shes | | zhes pa dang*/ phal po che'i mdo las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par byed | | thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong*// thos pas shes rab 'phel bar byed/ /shes rab kyis ni don rnam sbyong*/ /don mthong de ni bde thob 'gyur/ /bde thob de ni yid rno ste/ /tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan 'das | | zhes pa dang*/ shes rab rgyas byed pa ni thos pa ste/ /bsam pa dang ni gnyis po yod gyur na/ /de nyid bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyar/ /de la dngos grub bla na med pa 'byung*/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs mod kyi mdor bsdus na/ gsum ste/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba yin pas/ tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ sgro 'dogs bsal nas shes rab skye ba dang*/ kun gyis bstod cing bkur ba thob pa dang*/ lam bsgrub pa la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa gsum gyis tshe 'dir yon tan gyi chos thob pa dang*/ rim gyis thos bsam sgom pa la 'jug pas mthar sangs rgyas thob pa'o/ /gsum pa skabs don la sbyar ba ni rnam bshad rig pa las/ ras 'dul ba dang*/ dri ma can/ mi mnyam pa dang 'dra ba | nyan pa po dang*/ g.yeng ba dang*/ rmugs pa dang sgrib pa can yin la/ tshos rtsi mi bzang ba dang 'dra ba nyes pas spyad pa'i chos yin zhing*/ ri mo mi mkhas pa dang 'dra ba chos smra ba po yin no/ /de lta bas na chos la skyon med khyod dam bdag la skyon srid pas khyod kyis kyang gus par nyan cing bdag gis kyang gus par bshad par bya'o/ /zhes pas shes ldan dag de lta bas na khyod kyis kyang snod kyi skyon rnams spangs te/ chos thos pa'i phan yon de dag thugs la zhog la/ tshul de lta bus legs par gsan par mdzod cig dang*/ kho bos kyang bshad pa'i skyon de rnams spangs te phan yon de dag yid la bzhag la tshul de lta bus legs par bshad par bya'o/

/zhes brjod do/ /mdo sde las/ legs par nyon la yid la zungs shig dang ngas bshad do/ /zhes so// //༈ las dang byed pa 'bras bu yis//gzhung 'di'i skabs don rdzogs pa yin | | bdag blo byis pa'i spyod yul bas/ /nyes gyur mkhas rnams bzod par gsol | | de lta'i byung tshul don gsum ldan pa 'dis/ /gang zag skyon yon rtogs pas dri med dang*/ /blang dor gyi dmigs pa shes pas 'jug ldog bde ba dang | | sbyor dngos rjes gsum la mkhas pas lam du 'gyur ba'o// //༈ bcu phrag bcu tshe lo brgya pa'i dus la bde gshegs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyas | | nyi 'od 'das tshe thub pa'i gsung rab ma 'das pas gsung rab bsil zer byed pa shar/ /bsil zer 'od kyis dgra bcom ku mud kha phye ste/ /ku mud tshal na klu sgrub la sogs rgyal sras rma bya rtsom gar byed/ /gar gyis sde snod padmo go sla bar byung bas mdzes pa'i sbrang rtsi skyed/ /sbrang rtsi'i ro la lo tsā bas bsgyur bas so// snyan pa'i dri zhim phyogs bcur ldang*/ /dri rab zhim la blo gsal 'bre dang phywa gtsang la sogs kyi bung ba lang ling 'khor/ /bung ba'i dar dir rtsod rtsom 'chad pa'i/ sgra yis bdag gi tshad med glang chen g.yeng*/ / gla nga chen mgo las gzhan la phan par 'byung bas/ lhag bsam myos chu'i char zil 'bab/ /char gyis legs bshad du ma la bshad pas/ gli nga phran stong gi chu rgyun 'bebs/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu las chos 'byung rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ / yid 'ong mtsho de blo gros klu yi dbang pos sprul/ / ba'i shes rab kyis bya'o// // ༈ tsha zer sogs kyis legs mchod rgyal ba yis/ /gsung zer 'di brtsams dge ba kunda'i mdog /bsil zer 'od kyis nyon mongs gdung 'gro ba'i/ bsal ste/ /'od zer phun tshogs kun mkhyen myur thob shog /chos bshad nyan la 'jug pa spyi'i sgo/ /shākya'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po

sa sbyar ba/ rdzogs so// //༈ 'di'i brgyud pa bcom ldan 'das/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen | 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ dul ba'i sde/ mchog sde/ mkhan po rnam par snang mdzad bzang po/ seng ge bzang po/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs | gu ṇa mi tra/ ratna par pa ta/ gser gling pa/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ 'bre ar/ dol pa rdo rje dbang phyug rtag rdo rje seng ge rgyal mtshan/ grags pa seng ge des bdag la'o/ /sems can la phan bde'i 'byung gnas su gyur cig 'di nyid ma phyi gcig las ma rnyed cing*/ de yang shin tu ma dag pas/ yig nor mngon gsal can rnams bcos/ chad dam snyam pa dang*/ don go rgyu med pa 'ga' zhig 'dug par rtagasaX re byas yod/ slad ma dpe gzhan 'byor na bsdur bcos bya dgos so// // ༄༅/ /sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos bstod dbyangs kyi phreng ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ /bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la bstod pa/ sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos bstod dbyangs kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ gsung thams cad pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu gnas pa nā da'i sgra/ /kun 'gro'i gsung dang rab ldan pas/ /'gro ba so so'i skad rnams su | | dam chos gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bod la bod skad du/ /gsung phyir saṃ bho tra ( ṭa )la sogs/ /'jig rten mig rnams byin brlabs nas/ / bstan pa spel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brda' ( brda )rnams 'dod pa'i rjes 'brang yang | | mkhas pas bzhag pa'i brda' (brda )rnams la/ /bslabs pas dam chos rtogs par mdzad/ /mkhyen ldan khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bod kyi yi ge ma sum cu/ bu bzhi 'dogs dang 'phul rten bcas/ /mdzad nas bod la chos bstan pa/ khyod nyid lags phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu bzhi ma rnams phal la 'jug | ya btags bdun dang ra bcu gnyis/ /la btags bdun dang wa btags pa/ /bcu gnyis gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ho thub dbang khyod kyis ni

| | gya gyu spangs shing spyod yul dag /phyag 'os bya ba mdzad pa po/ /mya ngan brgal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis spel phyir khro ba spangs/ /snyan pa'i grags pas 'jig rten khyab/ /thrig thrig zer sogs mchil lh+wam dor/ /drang srong che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snrel zhi la sogs ting 'dzin gyis/ /spros pa phral nas rtog bral mdzad// ngur smrig bsnams shing sku bsrangs nas/ /hrig ge gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu dang glang pos sna slags te/ /bla ma dang zla med pa'i gsung*/ /mnyan na'ang rlom sems med pa'i chos/ /rtogs slar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kwa ye mgon khyed khwa mkhan dang*/ /gwa dor can dang bcwa lnga'i drwa | | rtswa zas can sogs dman pa la/ /lhag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan tshwa'i mtshor skyes dud 'gro dang*/ /zhwa lh+wam gos bral sgren mo dang*/ /zwa ltar reg na rtsub pa yi/ /sdug bsngal skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rwa can la sogs ngan 'gro'i mtshor/ /las kyi shwa 'ud kyis 'phangs nas/ /lus la mtshon gyis hwa bdod ( btod )pa'i/ /'jigs 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra bsam brjod pa dang bral yang*/ /ra la btags pa bcu gnyis dang*/ /lar btags bcu dang sar btags pa/ /bcu gnyis gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis gtso bos rga shi yi/ /zug rngu rje bos dgra bzhin bcom/ /'chi med bdud rtsi brnyes nas ni/ /rtag tu bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje lta sogs ting 'dzin gyis//rnam rtog rba rlabs ma lus bsal/ /rmad byung brtson 'grus chen po can/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lkog gyur bca' lga'i rgyu sogs kyang*/ /ye shes lnga ldan gyis mkhyen zhing*/ /lci yang chos kun ljags brkyangs nas/ /gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ngan ma lus bcom ldan gyis | | ko lpags rul dang lkog lba ltar// dor byar gzigs nas spong mdzad pa || lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgrib bral bas/

/bsngags 'os snyoms las med par chos/ /ston cing bdud sde sna tshogs rnams/ /spa skong ( bkong ) mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lba ba sbubs su nub pa dang*/ /sme ba med sogs mtshan ldan pas/ /mthong ma thag tu dang ba ni/ /stsol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phul yig ga da ba ma 'a// gas 'phul bcu gnyis ( gcig )das 'phul drug /ba ma 'as 'phul bcu bcu gcig /bcu rnams gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa nyag gcig gnyis med ston/ /gtong bsrung bsgom sogs gdams ngag gnang*/ /gtsang bdag med dang rtag pa'i gzhi/ /chos sku brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la gzigs pa mi g.yel bas/ /gdul bya'i drung du gshegs nas ni/ /dam chos gsung bas smin mdzad pa/ /thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab dkar dge la dngangs pa dang*/ /skrag pa sel mdzad dpa' bo che | | dbang bcu brnyes pa dman pa'i mgon/ /shākya'i gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' yis bdud rtsi bgo bya'i phyir/ /phyogs bcur sprul pa rnams btang nas// bdag med dam pa'i bdag ston pa/ /btsun pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhin bzang zla ba nya 'dra zhing*/ /bshad pa'i chos kyang dge legs kyi// dri bsung ldan pa spro mdzad pa//skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa'i/ /yon tan mnga' ba rkang gnyis mchog /mi mjed ston pa mnyam med pa/ /yang dag mthar bzhugs phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog mda' can dpung bcas kun/ /zil gyis mnan nas mtshan mi'i mthar/ /byang chub chen po brnyes par mdzad/ /dpa' chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khon 'dzin la sogs nye nyon rnams/ /'go ba'i nad dang 'chi bdag ltar/ /'jigs par gzigs nas 'thad pa yi/ /rigs pas 'dor la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags chen khyed kyis rab 'bad nas/ /'tshe ba'i rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin bcas rnams/ /rtsad nas bcom la phyag 'tshal la || mgon po khyod mthus mtha' rten gyi/ /yi ge ga nga da dang na/ /ba ma 'a dang

ra la sa/ /bcu rnams gsungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdeb sbyor bstod dbyangs kyi phreng ba las/ spyir bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //yi ge ma rnams sum cu po/ /re re rkyang pa 'dogs can dang*/ /'phul brten ci rigs sbyar ba yis/ /dam chos gsungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ka ba ke ke rus brgyan pa'i/ khang bzang kun spang ( spangs )do ker can/ /btsun mo keng rus ko g.yogs ltar/ /dgongs nas rab byung phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye khyod kye ma kye ho mtshar/ /kye ( kyi )hud sgrogs byed dmyal ba yang*/ /skyob nus kya kyor med par ni/ /dkyil dkrung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkor mdzod spangs nas dka' thub mdzad/ /'tshams ( mtshams )dkar can ( spyan )gyi dkyus ring zhing*/ / dku zlum sku dkyil mthong ba dkon/ /kun dkris bcad la phyag mtshal lo/ / bka' dang 'gal ba'i nyes kun bkag /bkris shing bcings pa thams cad bkrol | | bkab pa bsal zhing bkal ba phab/ /bkad sar bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhung bzed bkang ba phyag bkan pas/ /bsnams shing bkar nas bkri ba'i phyir/ /dge la bkol nas bkrabs pa'i 'khor/ /bkra shis mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkod legs rgyan bkram bkra ba'i gos/ /bkru ba'i khrus dang bkres sel sman/ /dri dang me tog bsil bkrol gyis/ /bkur stir 'os la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis dam pas rku ba dang*/ /sa rko rkyal pas rkyal la sogs | | ltung rkyang rkyen gyis rkyang sogs su/ /skye zhes bkag la phyag 'tshal lo | | rkan gtsang rked bsrang phyag brkyangs nas/ /sbyin pa gtong phyir brkam chags spangs*/ /lkugs pa mi mnga' lkog nad bral/ /lkog gyur gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs med skyob pa skyon med par/ /'gro skyong bde skyid skyed par byed/ /skye 'chi skyabs med skur 'debs dang*/ /skud ( skyud )mi mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rku zhing za dang skur dang skra/ / ska sogs ro dang skyer dang sman/ /rgya skyegs ske rags skud pa la'ang*/

/gnang bkag mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku la bya skyibs la sogs kyis/ /skor ba med kyang skyon mi 'byung*/ /skyor sngogs skar rtsis sku ba yi/ /lhung bzed bkag la phyag 'tshal lo/ / skal bzang thugs dam skyel che bas/ /bzhed na dkyil dkrung ( skyil krung )gcig gis kyang*/ /sa gsum bkab nas skal don skrod/ /'phong skyen khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa mang po'i nyams chags bskyang*//snying rjes bskyod nas gdul bya bskyangs// chos la bskul nas mngon mthor bskyal/ /phan bde bskrun la phyag 'tshal lo// bskum pa'i phyag dang bskor ba dang*/ /mchod rten rdo thal bsku sogs kyis// tshogs gnyis mtsho bskyil dge legs bskyed/ /nyes kun bskrad la phyag 'tshal lo//dge la bkol nas zhe sdang bskyungs*//'dod chags mtsho bskams ska mor mdzad/ /gdul bya theg chen la bskyon nas/ /thar par bskyel la phyag 'tshal lo/ khrel med khyams dang khron pa sogs/ /dngos po kun la'ang chags pa med/ khyi la sogs pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /chos skur khrid mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar mdzes pa'i bzhin/ /mkhur tshos dmar zhing mkhal khung mdzes/ /chags sdang nye 'khor btsun mo'i 'khor/ /ro 'drar mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku la 'khyor dang 'khyom pa dang*/ /'khyams dang 'khyar dang 'khungs (

'khums )mi mnga'/ /'khor bcas ngag 'khyal mi mnga' bar/ /'khod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bro mkhan 'khrab mkhas 'khyug lag can/ /'kho ru phab cing rgyan 'khrol bas/ /mchod 'os 'khor los bsgyur bas kyang*/ /'khur 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdzod spu g.yas su 'khyil ba dang*/ /'khril bag chags pa'i sku mnga' zhing*/ /'khrur 'jug rmed 'khal 'khyud sogs kyi/ /nyes ltung spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ral gri gru dang gres thag mkhan/ /gang la'ang grol bzhed khyed sku la/ /grum dang gram dang grang dang gṛb/ /bral ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod la gus na gra ba dang*/ /gra dor can dang ngam grog tu/ /skye ba 'gog pa'i gros 'debs shing*/ /dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grong dang gral dang grwa ldan gos/ /rnyed ma brnyed dang gro sar ni/ /grags dang ma grags la sogs pa//btang snyoms mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul bya dge la dgod dgongs dang*/ /skye rgu'i 'dud ( mdud )pa dgrol ba dang*/ /gzhan rgyud yon tan gyis dgang phyir/ /dgyes 'gur ( dgur )spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyar dgun dgung la dgon par ni/ /rnam rtog dgas dgug dgum pa'i phyir// dgag dgos rtsis la dgra thul zhes/ /'doms pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la dga' na lo dgu yang*/ /dge dgu med par ting 'dzin dgye/ /myur du thar par bgrod 'gyur zhes/ /gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bgres yon tan bgrang yas mnga'/ /chos bgro theg chen go cha bgos/ /sgom pa mi mnga' bgyi ba bgyis/ /nyon mongs bgar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po mgo yi skra mdzes shing*/ /mgul mgur mgrin pa dung 'dra la/ /bya ltar mgyogs bzhud rdzu 'phrul ldan//kun mgu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//rgyal bas 'grim 'gul ( 'grul ) mdzad pa'i lam/ /'gran zla bral bas brtson 'grus mdzad/ /'grim 'gag 'gyur med 'gog bden gzigs/ /don gnyis 'grub mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems 'gong 'gyel dang 'gyod dang 'gum/

/gzhan don 'gyangs shing 'gor ba dang*/ /g.yul 'gyed rnam rtog 'gyu sogs kyi/ /skyon bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed la 'ga' yis 'gom pa dang*/ /'gying dang mi 'grig 'gal byas kyang*/ /'gyes dang 'gas pa med pa yis/ /thar par 'god la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gar ba'i 'gron sogs sdig grogs dang*/ /'grogs pas 'gos nad thebs pa bzhin/ /ngan 'gror sdug bsngal 'gre ldon ( ldog )rnams/ /byang chub 'gron gnyer phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgod bag chos mthun rgol ba bral// gnas brtan rgan po chos rgyus mnga'/ /rgyu rgyud rang bzhin rigs kyi rgyun// chos skur phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyugs te rgo ba'i rgyab tu bsnun// rgyab nas bshus te rgyu lto rnams//rgyun bzhin za ba'i rngon pa la//lhag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal bas rga shi rgyang bsrings shing*/ /brgyad bkag rgyan gyis rgyags pa yang*/ /rgud bral bdud 'dul phyag rgya mdzad/ /rgya chen chos brnyes phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgyud dang bcas pa'i mya ngan brgal/ /sdug bsngal gyis brgyal brgya phrag la/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po yi/ /rgyan gyis brgyan mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ / lga skya la sogs sman rnams kyis/ /lgang pa'i nad sogs sel ba ltar/ /('di nas tshig rkang gnyis chad pa 'dra/) sgong skyes la sogs sdug bsngal gzigs/ /sga cha rta yi sgal par phyibs(chibs)/ /sgo nas phyir byung rab byung mdzad/ /'gro ba sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgom byed khyed kyis chos sgron sbar/ /sgro skur med pa'i sgrub byed kyis/ /yid sgul sems sgyur nyon mongs sgyel/ /sgrun du med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrung sogs sbre mo'i gtam rnams dang*/ /sgyug mo la sogs nye du'i 'khor/ /sgregs pa'i khrod kyi zas bzhin spangs | | dpa' chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsgrims nas bsgra phyir bka' bsgo ba/ /bsgom dang chos bsgrag bsgrub byar bstan/ /bsgre sogs lan gyis bstan pa yi/

/rgyal mtshan sgreng la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngul sogs dngos po'i dngos grub kyang*/ /dngos su stsol zhig dngangs skrag skyob/ /snyan dngangags mtshar du dngar ba'i bkas/ /lam ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngal gyi dri mas gos mi mnga'/ /mngag gzhug ro mngar rnga rngog can/ /rnga dang rnga chung sogs la yang*/ /chags bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rngon pa byed dang rngan pa len | | 'bu rngod rngul thon dub pa'i las/ /dgag pa mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyi rngo'i nad sogs zug rngu bral/ /bkra shis kyis ni brngas pa'i rtswa// gting (bting )nas mngon shes lnga sogs kyi/ /yon tan bskyed la phyag 'tshal lo | |snga dus sngon gyi bskal mang du/ / snga ོ ser la sogs zad par dang*/ /rig sngags bsngags 'os bsngo ba sogs/ /lam sbyong mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cang mkhyen sems can thams cad la/ /ci phyir cal col co 'dri sogs/ /cung zad ci nas cir ma grub/ /bya phyir brtson la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid gcugs gcugs pa'i gcen dang gcung*/ /gces dang yan lag gcud nas ni// gcong rong skyur nas srog gcod dgra/ /mnyam par dgongs la phyag 'tshal lo// gcig pur gcam bu smra ba dang*/ /gcig gam gshang (bshang )gci'i nang gnas dang | | gcer bu ba dang gcan gzan la/ /lhag par can dgongs phyag 'tshal lo | | dam bca' bcas pa las 'das pas/ /bcing bas bcangs (bcings )nas dmyal mer bcug /go bcad rkang bcag mig bcar ba'i/ /sdug bsngal sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa bcu phrag mtha' yas par/ /sdig pa ma bcabs lan chags bcal/ /bcos ma spangs nas bcol sa mdzad/ /bcom ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcud bcangs sems bcun yan lag bcun// ma bcus drang por lus bcur nas/ /brtson 'grus lcag gis lcam sring sogs// spangs nas bsgom la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang ma'i lcug ltar mdzes pa'i lus// lcags sogs rdzas lci lcing bde'i gtam//ma chags sneb (lceb )par rtsom pa la//brtse chen mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/

/thub chen 'gro ba'i don du chos/ /theg pa che chung chig dril du/ /cha shas chud ma zos par ston/ /bdud dpung choms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bar chad chu bo gzhom pa'i phyir/ /chem chem sogs su sa g.yos shing*/ khro bo 'chol pa spros nas ni/ /bdud dpung 'ching la phyag 'tshal lo | | 'chi bdag bcom zhing tshul 'chos spangs/ /'chel dang 'chus dang 'chug mi mnga'/ /'chun ldan rgyal srid 'chil ma bzhin/ /spangs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchu bsgrad mche gtsigs mchong rgyan can/ /mchod 'os khro bo mchog tu yang*/ /bstan pa bdud kyi snying mchin dang*/ /mcher ba g.yo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag cag khyed drung mchis nas ni/ /skyabs su mchi zhing mched grogs dang*/ /bcas te bka' mchid snyan pa yis/ /bstod cing gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ja sogs phud kyis je dang por/ /ji ltar 'bangs kyi (kyis )jo bo ltar | | mi mjed 'dul ba'i chos mjug dang*/ /mjal phyir mchod nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu 'jug mkhyen 'jig rten mgon/ /'jur 'dud med pa'i mnyam 'jog gis/ /nyon mongs 'jil zhing sdug bsngal 'ju/ /gzhal bya 'jal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jing nub 'jungs pa 'jud 'thun dang*/ /'jab bus rku dang 'jim las mkhan/ /'jam sogs 'jib byar chags rnams la// kun nas brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'ja' ltar yid la 'jem pa la/ /chags dang ha cang 'jol sogs dang*/ /rje la ma gus tshig rjod byed/ /rjes su spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhun brjid brjed med brjod bya'i don/ /rten 'brel sa (sā )lu ljang ba'i dpes/ /ljan ljin med ljongs ljon shing drung*/ /ljags brkyang gsung la phyag 'tshal lo//nya gang zla ltar yon tan gang*//nyi ltar ma rig mun pa sel || rtsa nyon nye nyon gnyis po spangs*//nyo tshong bkag la phyag 'tshal lo//nyan thos ma nyams don nyung zhing*//'gro 'chags nyal 'dug bag yod mdzad//gnyen spangs gnyes po gnyug ma sgom//de 'dra'i 'khor ldan phyag 'tshal lo/

/gnyid rmugs sogs spangs 'gro ba rnams/ /byang chub 'gron gnyer gnyan pa ltar// bsgral 'dod rnams kyis gnya' drag mdzad/ /don gnyis grub la phyag 'tshal lo || gsung mnyen mnyan 'os mnyam pa med//dge la mnyes shing rnyog pa med//rnyed la su (sems ) sogs 'ching ba'i rnyi/ /bcad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnyings dang rnyid pa mi mnga' zhing*/ /gzugs brnyan dman la'ang brnyas mi mdzad | | rdo rje'i sku brnyes snyel mi mnga'/ /snyengs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed kyi snyan mnyam snyim pa mdzes/ /btang snyoms mdzad kyang snyoms las med// gangs ri'i ngos la snye ma ltar/ /'khrungs pa dkon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tha snyad ngan rjes snyeg pa bral/ /bsnyel dang bsnyung ba bsnyung gnas spangs/ / glang chen bsnyon pa'i nga rgyal bsnyil/ /dam chos bsnyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting 'dzin mchog brnyes zhal ta mkhas/ khyed la tog can rgyal mtshan dang*/ /me tog la sogs mchod rdzas kyis/ /te por mchod 'os phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed sngon sku tshe gtan du ni/ /gtor ma la sogs sbyin gtong mdzad/ /gti mug spangs pas chos gtam la//spobs pa gtugs med phyag 'tshal lo//btsun mo gtams pa bzhes rnams kyang*/ /rin chen gter la'ang chags mi mnga'/ khro gtum med cing byams thugs ldan/ /byang chub che la phyag 'tshal lo/ khrag gtar rus pa gtun du brdungs/ /gtod la gtad nas gtar bzung sogs/ /'gro la brtse bas 'di ('od )bsrungs ma (la )//bstan pa gtad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs btul zhing sgro btags bton/ /bza' btung la sogs ci 'dod btang*// skyabs gnas btub pa khyod la ni/ /mgo bteg btud nas phyag 'tshal lo// rting yangs dbang po mi rtul bas/ /sems rtas rten 'brel tshul rtogs te// rtog med rta phyibs (chibs )khab tu byung*/ /rtag pa'i gnas brnyes phyag 'tshal lo | | brtul zhugs brtan pa brten byas nas/ /bden gnyis dang 'gal legs brtags te/ /ltos med lta ba rnams la ston/

/lte ba zab la phyag 'tshal lo | | mtha' bral lta ba'i ltor zhugs tshe/ /lha rnams ltad mo myong mdzad nas// glang chen rnam pas ltor zhugs te/ /bltam pa bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bltams tshe ltas mkhan gyis/ /yan lag bltabs te phyag byas nas/ /sti stang (stangs )bkur sti 'os pa yi/ /ston par lung bstan phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra sta stag pa la sogs rdzas/ /steng sogs phyogs dang ston sogs dus/ /stag sogs sems can stor sogs lus/ /stong par ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par sangs rgyas bu stor ba'i/ /ma bzhin brtse bas bde ster phyir/ /rdo rje'i stan la khyod sku bstan/ khyod thos stes legs phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstod 'os bsti gnas dben par bzhugs/ khyed kyi bstan pa gus bsten na/ /bsting tshig med par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thob mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag mtha' ni nyid kyis mthong*/ /tshul dang mthun pa'i mthu mnga' zhing*/ /mthe bo'i sen mo snum zhing mtho/ /zangs mdog 'dra ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ /'thad pa'i rigs pa 'thug po yis/ /bdag 'dzin 'thas pa 'thag par mdzad/ /zang zing 'thor la 'thar mi mnga'/ /sdig pa 'thol zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /dra zhing drubs pa'i na bza' bsnams/ /dred sogs drag po'i sems can gyi/ /drung du byon nas thar par drangs/ /mngon shes drug ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ /drod sogs drod che'i nad rnams bral/ /dril phyis drud la bden 'dzin med/ /dri ba lan ldon dran dang ldan | | drang srong mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug par gdags pa rngog pa'i gdon | | gdul phyir khro gdong hūm̐ sgra'i gdangs/( 'di nas tshig rkang gcig chad 'dra/ )/ gdeng thob khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyab gdal gdor nas gda' khyod la// gdung dang gdang ldan khang bzangs dang*/ /gdu bu gdugs dang gdan khri yis// gdud cing mchod 'os phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud las spangs shing bden gnyis dgongs | | bdog pa kun btang bde chen brnyes/

/byang chub yan lag bdun ldan la/ /bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs bde la bden pa bdar | | bdug pa sogs kyis mchod par 'os/ /mdor na mgon po khyod la ni | | mdud pa 'grol phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /mde can mda' dang mdung sogs mtshon | | dpral mdongs mdog mdangs ldan pa'i gzugs/ /mdun du byung yang khro chags med/ /mdo sde gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba 'dir/ /'khor ba 'dor dang 'dul bzhed pas/ /'dus pa'i 'khor la 'dar med par/ /dam chos 'don la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ni mya ngan 'das 'dug pas/ /'dom gang 'khor ba'i 'od mnga' zhing*/ /rtsod pa 'dum mdzad 'degs par mdzad/ /'dud 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dab chags bzhin du mkhar 'phags te/ /gdul bya 'dris dang ma 'dris kun/ /'dra bar 'dren phyir rdzu 'phrul rnams/ /('di nas tshig rkang gcig chad 'dra/)rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sdol (rdol )pa lta bu'i nyon mos (mongs )rnams/ /bcom phyir pheg sdob (rdob )la sogs kyis/ /bkur 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos ngan snod stong bzhin brdabs te/ /brdeg brdung la sogs nyes pa spangs*// kun rdzob chos kun brda tsam du/ /gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan dris na lan ldon zhing*/ /mkha' la lding zhing chos sgra ldir/ /ldar ldom (ldab ldib )mi mnga' lag pa dang*/ /lda ldis mchod 'os phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhe sdang la sogs sdig pa spangs*/ /sde bzhi 'dul ba'i sdeb sbyor mdzad/ /chos sdud la sogs sdom pa yis/ /sdug bsngal spong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdad pa'i gnas dang sdod pa'i stan/ /sdong pa'i sdog gu la sogs sman/ /sder sogs rdzas la chags pa bsdus/ /dbang po bsdams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gna' ma'i me tog snom sogs la'ang*/ /gnang bkag mgon pos gnag pas mdzad/ /gnam bzhin gnad 'jigs mi mnga' ba/ /gnas brtan chen por phyag 'tshal lo// gnod pa med par bdud dpung gnon/

/de la gnong 'gyod yong mi mnga'// mnal spangs mnar med la sogs rgyu/ /sgrib kun mnan la phyag 'tshal lo// rna ba dag cing blo gros rno/ /rnam rtog spangs pa'i rnam 'byor mdzad/ /rnam rtog la sogs mi dge rnams/ /rnag bzhin spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdog snum sna yi gzengs mtho zhing*/ /snam bya bzang po snams la snoms/ /chos kyi snang bas snod ldan rnams//skyong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhung bzed bsnams shing ngur smrig bsnabs//'gro la bde skyid bsnan pa'i phyir/ /lam bzang mtshon bsnun sdug bsngal bsnur/ /mthu chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pas pi wang 'dzin par yang*/ /bstan nas gdul bya chen po 'dul/ /dpa' bo dpal 'byor dpag med mnga'/ /dpe zla med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spang bya spangs pas mchod sprin gyis/ /spras pa 'jig rten spyi yi gnyen/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku yang*/ /spro mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//sprang po spra dang spre'u sogs// dman pa rnams la lhag par yang*/ /brtse bas sbyin sogs bzo rigs kyang*// bstan pa khyaud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi ma'i don la gtso bor 'doms/ khyam 'phyag 'phyang 'phrul 'bul ba bsngags/ /snying 'phyo ba med 'phye bo min// 'phags chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bya ba byas shing byed pa byas/ /bying rgod dang ni byur mi mnga'//byi ba bya sogs byol song rnams//byams pas skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byis pa byad gzungs ngan la brtse/ /byang sogs phyogs bcur 'od zer 'phro/ /rang byung byes nas byon med par/ /byang chub brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo

| | dbyings brnyes dbyig gi dbyangs ldan zhing*/ /dbyes che dbu ma chen po rig | dbyar gyi rnyed pa dbyung ba'ang gsungs/ /dbang phyug brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbugs ky-i 'khor lo kun bcad pas/ /dbul ba dbri zhing dbral ba dang*/ /dbyer med ye shes dbab par mdzad/ /dbu gdugs 'dra ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod gsung 'ba' zhig 'bad med par/ /chos skur 'bar ba'i 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /'brog gi 'bri dang 'bu sogs la/ /thugs rje cher 'bar phyag 'tshal lo/ /'bum sogs rgyas 'bring rab 'byams bka'// 'bur du dod te sku gzugs kyang*//'byer dang 'bo 'bral 'brid med pa// bkur bar 'os la phyag 'tshal lo//'bog dang 'bugs dang 'bros mi mnga'// 'bras sogs 'bru dang me tog sogs//rnams dang zung du 'byar ba'i gos// 'bul 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtog pa'i rba rlabs ma lus zhi/ /rgyal srid bde ba lbu ba dang*/ /lbo ba'i nad dang lkog lba bzhin/ /gzigs nas spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sba bya sbubs su sbed par mdzad/ /sgrib gnyis sbyangs nas legs sbyar gsungs// sbrum ma sbom dang sbrang bu la'ang*/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam chos bdud rtsi sbrengs nas ni/ /gzhan rgyud gyong po sba (sbang )bar mdzad/ /sbrid pa sbru dang sbo la'ang chos/ /ma sbran gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// myur dang mya ngan bsgral ba dang*//thar pa'i mu (myu )gu bskyed pa'i phyir/ /'dod pas myos dang myul sogs spangs/ /bde chen myong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmag mi dman sogs dma' rnams dang*/ /dmus long dmu rgod lag dmar dang*// dmigs mi phyed pa'i dmyal ba rnams/ /brtse bas 'dren la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rma dang rm-i lam rmang nas med/ /rmongs dang rmugs pa rmas mi mnga'/ /rmig pa can la rmo ba'ang 'gog/ rmad byung khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sme ba smyan sogs smad pa'i las/ /smre sngags smra ba smeg med byas/ /smin ma ring ba smon par 'os//

sman pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /smod mo dang ni smug rtsi spangs/ /smyug ma'i tshal bzhin dge legs smin/ /'gro ba'i smos 'drin thub chen la/ /bdag cag rtag par phyag 'tshal lo//gtso bo'i dbu la gtsug tor ldan/ /gtse ba bral zhing gtsang sar gnas/ /mche ba gtsigs pa'i khro bor yang*/ /ston pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /btsan po'i rigs su btsas khyod kyis/ /btsun pa'i gos la btsag tshos gnang*/ /btsod sogs btsal dkar btsos pa bkag /btson ra rgal (brgal )la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchu gtsir kha btsums smra ba dang*/ /ma btsags chu dang btsong la sogs//btsog pa'i zas la spyod spangs nas/ /bstan pa btsugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge rtsa bskyed pa'i rtse mor byon/ /rtsod pa'i las dang rtsod pa spangs//thugs rtsing rtsed mo'i rtsol ba bral/ /rtsi sman mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs rtsig pa kun bshig cing*/ /rtsibs logs mdzes pa rtsis las 'das//rtsom pa thams cad don ldan 'gyur/ /brtsams pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse ldan brtson pas dkon brtsegs sogs/ /brtsod (rtsod )du med pa'i gsung rab rnams/ /bka' stsol dngos grub stsal 'os la/ /stsal (bstsal )ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshal ltar ljags dmar ngo mtshar ba'i// mtshan dpe mtshan nyid tshang bas spras/ /mtshang 'dru mtshon cha len pa spangs// ye shes mtsho chen phyag 'tshal lo/ /'tsho ba 'tshog chas bzang 'tshe med/ /'tsham par chos 'tshal 'tshed pa dang*/ /brdeg 'tshog spangs nas gdung 'tshob phyir// 'tshang rgya'i tshul bstan phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam chos mdzod brnyes 'gro kun la'ang | | mdza' bos bzhin du mdzad pa mdzes/ /mdze nad med de byang chub sems | | 'dzag pa spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdig pa 'dzems la thar par 'dzegs | | 'dzum ldan 'dzangs pa 'dzam gling 'dir/ /'thun par sangs rgyas zhes 'dzer ba/ /de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan rdzogs/ /ba mchog rdzi dang rdzu 'phrul can/ /'dus byas kun rdzob rdza bum ltar

| | 'jig par ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzing sogs chu nang gos brdzes nas | | rtse phyir 'jug pa dgag par mdzad/ /sus kyang khyed stobs brdzi mi mnga' || brdzun med bslu med phyag 'tshal lo//pi wang lta bur snyan pa'i gsung*// wa ti'i chu bzhin kun la snyoms//wa sogs gcan gzan gdug pa la'ang*/ /phan bde dgongs la phyag 'tshal lo//nyes kun gzhol dang gzhom pa dang*/ /gdul bya gzhan dag gzhug pa'i phyir/ /gzhi lnga'i rnam gzhag gzhung las gsungs// chos skur gzhol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhong thogs la sogs lha gzhon nu'i// lang tsho'ang gzhon dang dbang po'i gzhu/ /ltar gzigs gzhal yas yon tan gyis | | mtsho ('tsho )zhing gzhes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhang 'brum zhing sogs gzugs rnams kyang*/ /phan bzhed de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug bzhengs la bzhugs/ khyed la rtag par phyag 'tshal lo// bzhad gad spangs shing rgyal srid bzhag /theg gsum bzhon pa brtson 'grus kyi || lcag gis bzhus shing bskul nas ni/ /thar par bzhud la phyag 'tshal lo// lam bde (bden )chu brgal gzings shing (bzhin )gzigs/ /gzugs sogs gzung 'dzin gzod nas ni (zhi)/ /gzegs zan sogs la'ang gzu bor dgongs | | gzi brjid ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzigs (gzig )sogs gzar 'os sems can dang*/ /gza' dang gzer gyis gzir la sogs/ /'gro ba gzud phyir gzabs pa'i chos/ /gsung bar ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdeg gzas sgo (bsgo )ba rna la gzon/ /gzar por 'dzeg dang sbyin bdag la/ /ha cang gzan sogs nyes pa kun/ /spang byar gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzar bus drangs pa'i bza' ba rnams/ /lhung bzed bzung nas bza' bar ston// bzi ba mi mnga' kun nas bzang*/ /btud cing btud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal bzod dka' yang*/ /bzo sogs rig pa'i gnas lnga gsungs/ khyed kyi bka' drin mi dran (brjed )pas/ /bzengs bstod yang yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.ya' bral btso ma gser gyi mdog

/g.yem dang g.yel dang g.yeng ba dang*/ /g.yal dang g.yan pa g.yo sgyu med/ /g.yung drung sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yab mo g.yob dang g.yen spyod (spyos )dang*/ /mig ni g.yas g.yon zur blta bkag /g.yog 'khor mi phyed ldan khyod la/ /g.yar ngo phyar nas phyag 'tshal lo//g.yon khyod bltams tshe sa g.yos shing*//shing rnams 'bras bu g.yur zar gyur/ /g.ye thang rnams la'ang 'bru bcud 'khrungs/ /dpal g.yang che ldan phyag 'tshal lo//chu klung gnas pa'i klu rgyal ni// klog char nam mkha'i mthas klas 'bebs/ /nus ldan de yang khung glag phyir/ khyed la 'dud cing phyag 'tshal lo/ / gla rtsi'i dri dang glu gar dang*/ / gla da pa glo ba gling sogs la'ang || chags bral glan ka spangs pa yi/ /glegs bam gsung la phyag 'tshal lo || blo gros chen pos blang dor mkhyen//bla ma blon po rin chen gyis//mchod 'os blun tsheg mi mnga' bas// mkhas mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lugs su blug pa'i sku blus na'ang*/ /bsam pa dge na nyes med gsung*/ /zla ba zlum 'dra'i zhal mnga' ba/ /zlos bu bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyed gsung bzlas la bzlog pa ni/ /rlung sogs 'byung ba'ang ma mchis la/ /rlom sems rba rlabs rlon pa yi/ /bla med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlig pa med la dge slong bkag/ dad ldan rnams la byin gyis rlob/ /byin rlabs thugs rjes thugs brgyn pa'i || sangs rgyas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod snyoms slong ba'i slob ma la// sla mos bdud rtsi sogs pas slad/ /bla med dam chos ma slad par/ /bslabs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i tog ldan pa'i/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan khyod kyis bslang*/ /bsten na bslu ba yong mi mnga'/ /de phyir btud nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /klo bur zhes pa rgyu med la/ / glo bur sngar med gsar byung la/ /blo bur dri ma 'bral rung du/ /gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gshin rje'i gshed mas bzung nas ni/

/lce la gshol gyis gshog pa las/ khyed la (las )skyabs gzhan gshis la med/ /bde gshegs khyed la phyag 'tshal lo || drod gsher sgang gshong gshe ba med/ /phyi bshol bshang gci bshal dgos med || bshas shing bshus nas bshig tu med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bshes gnyen 'dab bshog med par 'phur/ /legs bshad gsung la bshos bzang 'bul/ /sdig la 'gyod nas 'thol zhing bshags/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /su la bud med rab byung gnang*/ /gsad bya gsod dang gso bar nus/ /gsang sngags gsan nas gsal bar gsungs/ khams gsum sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun rdzob gsog gsob brdzun par gsungs/ /gsus pa'ang gser mdog gsong por smra/ khyed la gson nam shi ba na'ang*/ /skyabs su gsol phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams bsags shing bsam gtan bsgoms | | rnam rtog bsad cing sgrib gnyis bsal/ /bla ma bsu nas bsil ba bsrol/ /bser ma bsengs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po bsrungs nas nyon mongs bsregs/ /mi shes mun pa bsad pa'i phyir/ /mnyam rjes bsres pa'i nyams len gnang*/ /tshul khrims bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi lha sogs sku lham me/ /lhan ne lhang nge lhod der bzhugs/ /lho sogs phyogs bcur phrin las ni | | lhub par lhun grub phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang bcad dang gcad pa dang || bzhag dang gzhag dang bzung dang gzung*/ /bsad dang gsad sogs 'das pa dang*/ /ma 'ongs don ston phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed bsgom dang sgom/ /brjod rjod dang blta lta (brjod bya rjod byed blta dang lta)/ /bya ba dang ni byed pa'i tshul/ /gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdeb sbyor bstod dbyangs kyi phreng ba las so sor bshad pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //tsheg bar snga ma'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /rjes kyi tshig phrad thob tshul yang*/ khyod mthus mkhas pa rnams kyis bstan/ /de phyir khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ba sa yi mthar kyi dang*/

/ga nga'i mthar ni gi sbyar zhing*/ /na ma ra la gyi sbyar ba/ khyod mthur shes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'a dang rkyang pa 'dogs can mthar/ /'i sbyar gal te tshigs bcad kyi/ /tsheg bar nyung na yi sbyar ba/ khyed mthu lags phyir phyag 'tshal lo/ /ga da (dang )ba yi rjes su tu/ /nga dang (da )na ma ra la du/ / sa su ba ('a )dang rkyang pa dang*/ /'daugs can tur (rur )gsung phyag 'tshal lo// na ra la mthar du yin yang*/ /gang du da drag sbyar ba der/ /tshig phrad yi gi (ge )tu thob par/ /gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da na ra la sa mthar te || ga nga ba ma 'a rnams la (dang )/ /rkyang pa 'dogs can mthar te (ste )yang*/ khyod mthus byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ga ba sa yi rjes su kyang*/ /nga na ma 'a ra la dang || rkyang pa 'dogs can mthar yang du/ /gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// res 'ga' rkyang pa 'dogs can mthar/ /'ang sbyar tshigs bcad tsheg bar nyungs (nyung )/ /de tshe yang yang sbyar bar gsungs*/ /thabs mkhas khyod la phyag mtshal lo/ /ga da ba cing sa mthar shing*/ /nga na ma 'a ra la dang*/ /rkyang pa 'dogs can rnams la zhing*/ /sbyor bar bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ga da ba ces nga dang na/ /ma 'a ra la sa rnams dang*/ /rkyang pa 'dogs can mthar zhes ni | | 'thad par gsungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ga da ba dang rkyang pa cig /nga na ma 'a ra la dang*/ /'dogs can zhig ste sa mthar shig /thugs rjes byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na ra la rjes zhig yin yang*/ /gang du da drag sbyar ba'i sa// cing zhes gcig tu 'thob par gsungs/ /smra mkhas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ga da ba mthar ce na dang*/ / sa mthar she na nga na ma/ /'a ra la dang rkyang 'dogs can | | zhe na gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ga da ba na'i (sa'i )nges par pa/ /nga na ma 'a ra la dang*/ /rkyang pa 'dogs can mthar sa (pa )dang*/ /ba yi khyad gsung phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri ba'i skabs kyi mthar (mtha' )brten la/ /ma sbyar da drag can la tam/ /rkyang pa 'dogs can 'am sbyar ba/ /'thad par bzhed la phyag 'tshal lo/

/rdzogs tshig skabs su mthar (mtha' )brten la/ /na ro sbyar bya de ltar na'ang*/ /da drag can la to sbyar ba/ /rigs par gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs tshig 'dogs can rkyang pa'i mthar/ /'o sbyar de ltar mtha' ru ni/ /shad dang tsheg gi 'jug tshul yang*//rtogs byar gsung la phyag 'tshal lo//gzhan yang mkhas pas brtags nas ni//brjod pa bde ba'i rjod byed kyis//chos don bstan par rtogs bya ba/khyod mthur rtogs nas phyag 'tshal lo//mdor na mtha' 'khob bod yul 'dir//theg gsum dam chos dar ba 'di/ /thub dbang khyed kyi mthu yin phyir/ /bka' drin dran pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdeb sbyor bstod dbyangs kyi phreng ba las/ tshig gi phrad kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de ltar thub dbang bstod pa las/ /byung ba'i dge ba gang thob des/ / mkha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus rnams/ /bstod 'os sangs rgyas myur thob shog / bcom ldan 'das la bstod pa sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos/ bstod dbyangs kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ skad gnyis kyi brda' (brda )la blo'i snang ba thob pa/ ā nanta dhwa dza la mkhas pa chen po bsod nams grags dang*/ dge slong bkra shis bde legs kyis yang dang yang du gsol ba btab nas/ chos gnas chen po dpal ldan sa skyar sbyar ba'o/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // 'di'i nang gi sngon gyi 'bri srol rnams rang sor bzhag the tshom dpyad par 'os pa rnams dang*/ yi ge bas nor ba yin nges rnams kyang*/ bcos thal ma byas par gug rtags nang du bkod de zhu dag byas yod/ 'on kyang ma yig gcig las med phyir tshig rkang chad pa rnams skabs so sor dogs slong mchan chung 'god pa las bya thabs ma byung bas/ rjes su ma dpe dag pa 'byor tshe gsab 'bri dgos pa don gnyer can rnams kyis dgongs par mdzod// // ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa bdud rtsi spel ba bzhugs so/

/ ༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'tshal lo/ /bcu phrag bdun dang lnga phrag rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi/ khro bo bcu gcig gcig /dpal ldan dkyil 'khor gnyis khro bo dang khro mo'i rim pa gnyis la/ bsgrub par/ /btud de gang zag dbang po rno rtul| rnam bzhi gzung ba'i phyir/ /brgya phrag phyed kyis bla ma dbye/ /'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po/ birwa pa'i gsung gi gdams pa/ dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po las rim par brgyud pa'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa | rgyud sde bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i man ngag gcig nas gcig tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i brgyud pa ma chad pa ngo mtshar ba dang bcas pa 'di bri ba la skyon med do/ /de'ang rgyud las/ rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ /dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan/ /zhes 'byung bas/ gang zag sbyangs pa che 'bring bzhi'i bye brag gis/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang sgo bstun nas/ mngon par rtogs pa gcig nyid la bye brag mi 'dra ba bzhi 'byung ba yin te/ 'di ltar mdun du bskyed na bya ba'i rgyud/ bdag dang mdun gnyis kar bskyed na spyod pa'i rgyud/ bdag 'ba' zhig bskyed de ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su mi gsol na rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ky-i rim pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i tshul de dag bsgom pa la gsum ste/ thabs kyis bsrung ba dang*/ shes rab kyis bsrung ba dang*/ gnyis su med pas bsrung ba'o/ /dang po ni dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i rjes la

byams snying rje'i bar du bzhag go |rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas/ rgyas par byed na rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnam 'joms su bskyed pa'i snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis/ bla ma dang bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs kyi zhing spyan drangs/ snying kha nas pū tsa'i yo byad dpag med spros la mchod/ yan lag bdun pa bya gsung*/ gtso cher tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa tsam phyag len mdzad do/ / sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa bsgom snyam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ chos thams cad sems bya ba nas rang bzhin med pa'i bar bsgom la shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas dngos po thams cad nam mkha' ltar yul snang ba mi dmigs pa stong par bsgom pa'o/ /gsum pa ni stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer spros pas rdo rje'i ra ba gur bla re dang me ri 'bar ba/ de'i nang du bhrum̐ gzhal yas khang spyi dang mthun| dbus tsakra bsams kyang btub gsung*/ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las padma raṃ las dbus kyi/ nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan phyogs brgyad kyi nyi ma'i steng du phyogs skyong brgyad/ steng du nyi zla gnyis/ 'og tu sa bdag phag pa/ no/ /de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od spros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ ma rgad ltar ljang ba/ cung zad khros pa/ yid tsam 'dzum pa/ phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas 'phyar/ g.yon thugs kar/ bzhengs pa'am zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum yang gsung*/ rang snang gi yum dang bcas par bsgom na g.yas brkyang par ro/ / g.yon pas dril bu dkur 'chang ba zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa

pa'o || de'i thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa spyan drangs thugs khar bzhugs pas lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams/ de nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las/ 'byin pa'i tshul du ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ khro bo bcu sku mdog phyag mtshan spyi dang mthun/ rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba bzhin phyogs bcur spros la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ gtso bo tha mi dad pas byang du rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad nag po rdo rje dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba 'khor lo 'dzin pa thams cad zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'o// phyi rol gyi 'phar ma la rdo rje pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su brgyad/ phyag g.yas pa rnams/ shar dang*/ shar lhor rdo rje/ lho dang lho nub ratna rdo rje/ nub dang nub byang padma/ byang dang byang shar rgya gram/ g.yon sdigs mdzub bo// brgyad spros de yang*/ kye rdo rje ma/ don yod rdo rje ma/ rdo rje gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje bde bar 'gro ma/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ma/ rdo rje las thams cad ma/ rdo rje thugs ma/ rdo rje sdig pa 'joms par byed ma ste brgyad shar du'o/ /rdo rje bum pa ma/ rdo rje lta ba ma/ rdo rje don grub ma/ rdo rje las ma/ rdo rje dam tshig ma/ rdo rje ku ru ma/ rdo rje pra ma ri ma/ rdo rje dbang du byed ma ste brgyad shar lhor ro/ /rdo rje zhags pa ma/ rdo rje rmongs byed ma| rdo rje 'dren byed ma/ rdo rje gzhan gyi rig sngags 'ching ma/ rdo rje gzhan gyi rig sngags phyir gsol ma/ rdo rje dgyes ma/ rdo rje me ma/ rdo rje mig sman ma ste brgyad lho ru'o/ /rdo rje bsnubs pa ma/ rdo rje srung ma/ rdo rje don byed ma/ rdo rje lte ba ma/ rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ rdo rje snying rje'i zhags pa ma/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/

rdo rje mgyogs ma ste brgyad lho nub tu'o/ /rdo rje len pa ma/ rdo rje thams cad 'phrog ma/ rdo rje glang ma/ rdo rje ri khrod ma/ rdo rje snum pa ma/ rdo rje mdzes pa'i snyems ma/ rdo rje me tog snyims pa ma/ rdo rje theg pa ma ste brgyad nub tu'o/ /rdo rje gdon dang rims nad kyis thebs su 'jug ma/ rdo rje byed pa ma/ rdo rje blo gros ma/ rdo rje sgra ma/ rdo rje khro ba ma/ rdo rje gnas mdzes ma/ rdo rje gtum mo/ rdo rje gzhig pa ma ste brgyad nub byang du'o/ / rdo rje shing lo ma/ rdo rje nges par gnod mdzes ma/ rdo rje 'dod ma/ rdo rje phur bu ma/ rdo rje smra ba ma/ rdo rje dgod ma/ rdo rje mi 'jigs pa sbyin ma/ rdo rje spyan drangs ma ste brgyad byang du'o/ /rdo rje rab grub ma/ rdo rje dga' bar byed ma/ rdo rje rang byung ma/ rdo rje thub pa ma/ ngag gi rdo rje ma/ rdo rje dbang du byed ma/ rdo rje thig le ma/ rdo rje bsrung ba ma ste brgyad byang shar te/ de'ang de dag ni sku mdog shar gyi rnams dkar po | lho'i rnams ser po/ nub kyi rnams dmar po/ byang gi rnams ljang khu/ mtshams kyi rnams phyed gzugs so/ /de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis | shar gyi rnams kyi phyag g.yas pa 'khor lo/ lho'i rin po che/ nub kyi padma | byang gi ral gri/ byang shar gyi mig gis spras pa'i 'khor lo/ shar lho'i rdo rje | lho nub kyi padma/ nub byang gi utpal/ g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /yang na thams cad kyang rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par bsgoms kyang rung zhes gsungs so/ /de nas ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ sku skye mched mi dgos gsung*| gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab ste/ de'ang gshin rje'i gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ padma mthar byed la 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /gtso bo la sogs pa gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pa'o/

/rdo rje pho nya mo rnams la shar la sogs pa'i rim pa ltar rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ don yod grub pa'o/ /byang shar gyi la rnam snang/ shar lho'i la mi bskyod pa/ lho nub kyi la 'od dpag med/ nub byang gi la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par dbang ma bskur bar dbu rgyan rang chas su bsams kyang rung gsung*/ bya'o/ /mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas sngags kyi bzlas pa la gnyis te/ bsnyen pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ nye snying bzlas pa gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi'o/ /snying po khro bo bcu dang thun mong ba'o/ /rtsa sngags rdo rje pho nya mo rnams dang thun mong yang na gsum ka'ang gnyis ka'i thun mong bar bstan te/ rtsa sngags kyi na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo tsaṇḍa badzra pā na ye zhes gtso bo'o/ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye zhes khro bo bcu yi'o/ /oṃ truṭa zhes pa man chad rdo rje pho nya mo'i'au||snying po'i pā na ye zhes pa yan chad gtso bo'i'o/ /mahā yakṣa se na pa ta ye dang*/ oṃ ha ra la sogs pa khro bo bcu'i'o | | gsham gyi hūm̐ phaṭa pho nya mo'i 'o/ /nye snying gi na maḥtsaṇḍa badzra kro ta ya gtso bo'i'o/ /oṃ hu lu hu lu la sogs khro bo bcu'i'o/ /hūm̐ phaṭa pho nya mo'i'o/ /zlos pa'i tshe thog mar nye snying de nas snying po dang rtsa sngags te mas rim nas lan 'ga' bzlas zer/ gang ltar yang lha'i sku la dmigs so// ba'o/ /de nas gsang sngags de dag mtshan ma mthong ba'am/ 'bum phrag bzhi la sogs par bsnyen pa sngags gsum ka bzlas pas ma grub na/ gang bzlas kyang rung gsung*/ yang na las sbyor la bzhir gsung ste/ bzlas bsgom la brten pa dang*/ 'phrul 'khor dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ bum pa la brten te las sgrub pa'o// bya'o/ /las la sbyar ba ni/ gang zag rab bsam gtan la brten pa tsam gyis 'grub bo/ /'bring bsam gtan dang sngags la brten pa tsam gyis 'grub bo/

/tha ma de dag gi steng du 'khor lo la brten te 'grub bo/ /shin tu tha mas kyang de dag gi steng du sbyin sreg gi las kyis 'grub bo/ /dang po zhi rgyas la sogs pa gang sgrub kyang mngon par rtogs pa bsgom zhing*/ sdig pa zhi ba dang tshe rgyas pa la sogs pa ji ltar bsam pa de dang de thogs pa med par 'grub bo || dbus su rta mgrin byon/ de'i sar rnam 'joms bzhugs nas bzlas na dbang gi las 'grub/ des las gsum 'gre'o// gnyis pa ni/ yid kyis snga ma bzhin bsam la/ ngag gis shanti ku ru la sogs pa'i las so so'i spel tshig dang bcas pa'i/ snga ra gyi sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub ba/ /gsum pa ni/ bri ba'i gzhi gro ga'am/ ras sam/ shing shun la'o// snag tsha tsanda dkar po dang*/ srin lag gi rgyun dang*/ rgya skyegs dang*/ gur gum dang | ghi haṃ dang*/ dug dang*/ khrag dang*/ ske tshe dang*/ nyungs dkar rnams rim pa bzhin | zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon spyod rnams la'o/ / 'khor lo'i dbyibs ni/ rtsibs bcu pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ nye snying spel tshig dang bcas pa/ rtsibs bcu la snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa/ mu khyud la rtsa sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bri'o/ /de la rab tu gnas pa legs par byas la/ bdag gzhan bsrung ba'am/ zhi ba la de dang de la gdags so | | rgyas pa la ni/ gtsug lag khang du mchod pa bya'o/ /dbang la ni/ za ma tog la sogs pa'i nang du/ mar dang sbrang rtsi'i nang du'o/ /mngon spyod la ni/ mchod rten la sogs pa'i 'og tu'o/ /shin tu tha mas sbyin sreg la brten pa ni/ thab bskyed pa spyi dang mthun/ kyi dbyibs dang tshad la sogs pa las bzhi'i bye brag kha khyer zhi ba la sor bzhi phyir bskyed cing dpangs su yang sor bzhi'o/ /rgyas pa la sor brgyad dang*/ dbang la sor bzhi/ drag po la sor gsum mo// gis tha dad par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi 'jig rten pa'i me lha zhi ba la rnam snang*/

rgyas pa la rin 'byung*/ dbang la 'od dpag med/ drag po la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bskyed pa/ mchod pa'i rjes la/ lha rnams bskyed la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /bsreg rdzas ni/ til dang*/ zho dang*/ utpal dang*/ tsher ma can rnams zhi ba la sogs pa la rim pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /yang lhag mas 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa la sogs pa thams cad gzhan dang thun mong ba yin no/ /mngon par rtogs pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mtha' dag bstan zin to/ /gal te rang gzhan gyi don du bum pa la brten te khrus kyi cho gas las bzhi bsgrub par 'dod na/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la mgul chings dang kha rgyan dang bcud bcugs te/ skad cig gis oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmaḥswa bha wa shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las bhru?m̐ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par bskyed la de'i nang du sngar bshad pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa cho ga bzhin bskyed nas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya ste/ bum pa'i steng du dung chos su dri chu blugs pa bzhag pa'i steng gi rdo rje la gzungs thag btags la/ rgyud thog mar gleng gzhi nas brtsams te lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so yan chad lan gcig brjod la gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ de nas gzungs ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ ril po rdzogs pa lan gcig gzhan rtsa sngags dang snying po dang nye snying rnams lan gsum mam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad du gdon zhing*/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ lha rnams dmar por gyur pa bsams pas/ bdag gi dbang du 'dus te de rnams las 'od byung bas/ bdag la phog pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing bzlas so/ /de'i mthar dung chos kyi chu blugs la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i chur bsam la | rang ngam de nas/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /zhes pa nas brtsams te/ sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/

/zhes pa yan chad lan cig brjod la bum chu de/ gzhan la blud pa dang*/ gtor ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'ang zhi ba la sogs pa la kha dog gi dbye ba snga ma bzhin no/ /rgyud sde bzhi dang rjes su bstun na/ bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud la bum pa'i steng du lha bsam la/ de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bum par babs par bsam zhing bzlas la/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen por byed na bum pa'i nang du lha bsam mo/ /da ni gzhung gi cha cung zad dgrol bar bya ste/ de'ang bsnyen pa dang*/ las la sbyor ba ston par byed pa'i gzhung gnyis las/ dang po ni | 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i zhes bya ba nas/ rdo rje snying pos rab tu smras te zhes bya ba'i bar gyis gtso bo 'i thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so yis bstan/ hūm̐ las 'od byung bas sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med spyan drangs te/ lus rdo rjer byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rjo rjes lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas zhes pa dang*/ de nas lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bstan to// bskyed pa'o/ /mi chod pa zhes la sogs pa las sbyor gyi gzhung du'ang mdzad/ bya ba nas | | rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa zhes bya ba'i bar gyis khro bo bcu bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la gnyis las/ sems can thams cad saṃ skṛ ta'i sgra la e baṃ zhes pa yin la baṃ gis thabs kyi bsrung ba bstan/ e yis shes rab kyi bsrung ba'o| | bsrung ba zhes bya ba yan chad yan lag gi las yin la/ lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras te zhes bya ba yan chad rtsa ba'i las yin no/ /rgyas par gzhung gi cha nyid du shes par bya'o/ /mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis mngon par rtogs pa zab pa'i rim pa mtha' dag bstan zin to/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug dri med gdams pa'i rgyun/

/ma 'dres mtha' dag gang gis brnyes gyur pa/ /bla ma'i gsung rab gus pas 'dod pa la/ /ji ltar rtogs bzhin rjes su bstan pa yin/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ bdud rtsi spel ba zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa gsang sngags 'dzin pa chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan la | dge bshes 'ong rus yang yang du bskul nas byas pa dang*/ rang gi brjed byang du sbyar ba'o// //rdzogs so// dge'o// //༄༅/ /dur khrod thod pa'i brtag thabs bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /mahā gu ru sarba na mo/ badzra ḍā ki ṇi sarba na mo/ dur khrod thod pa'i brtag thabs la/ /mdor bsdus man ngag bstan pa ni/ /dum bu dbyibs dang kha dog dang*/ /srab mthug rtsa dang ri mo dang*/ /yang lci mkhregs sob 'jam rtsub dang*/ /rang sa dgra sa nor sa dang*/ /pho mo'i rigs dang bug pa dang*/ /de ltar rnam pa bco lnga'o/ /tshang na nor bu rin po che/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bzang ngan phyed ma srel du btub/ /skyon mang yon tan nyams pa yi/ /ngan pa tshang ba'i thod pa ni/ /dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i thun snod bya/ /phal cher bzang ngan skyon yon shes/ /dum bu gcig pa rab kyi rab/ /

du ma bu gsum pa rab kyi 'bring*/ /dum bu bzhi pa rab kyi mtha'/ /dbyibs sgong bcad pa lta bu rab/ /padma'i 'dab ma lta bu 'bring*/ /sgo nga bshags pa lta bu mtha' | kha dog dkar ser dmar la smug /bkrag mdangs ldan zhig 'tsher ba'o/ /mthug la bar gyi lha ba chung*/ /yul snyoms srab mthug khyad par chung | | rtsa ro srin khung la sogs pa'i/ /skyon drug med pa'i ka pā la/ /ri mo shing lo rgyas pa yi/ /yal ga'i rtse la 'bras bu chags/ /rtse mo tshangs bug snyog pa 'dra/ /ri mo zhib tu brtags pa na/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan nam// phrin las zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi/ /grub pa'i rtags su ri mo yong*/ /de rnams 'tshogs na bzang ba'i rab/ /'ga' tsam 'dug na bzang ba'i 'bring*/ shing lo legs na bzang ba'i mtha'/ /lci zhing mkhregs pa'i ka pā la/ /phyi nang gnyis ka shin tu 'jam/ /'tshogs ma sor bzhi rang gi sa/ /dbus (u )zur shin tu rno gyur na/ /g.yang grogs mkhar du brtsigs pa yin/ /spyi bo sor bzhi nor gyi sa/ /dbus na shong bu bzhi'am gnyis/ /mar dkar mtheb mos mnan pa 'dra | | 'dod 'jo'i ba zhes (rjes )bya ba yin/ /ltag pa sor bzhi dgra yi sa/ / zlum por song na bzang ba yin/ /pho thod rigs bzang bsod nams can/ / tshangs pa'i bu ga thal byung na/ /de rnams ldan pa'i ka pā la/ /bcangs na dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /dum grangs drug gnyis brgyad pa'am/ /'chol dum mang ba bcang mi 'dod/ /ba glang rgyab 'dra yon po dang*/ /ljong mo'i rgyab 'dra zur gsum dang*/ / sngo nag sngo skya ser nag dang*/ /dkar sob dmar sob srab pa dang | | sob la thal chen 'dra ba dang*/ /sgang mthug khong srab ma snyoms dang*/ / thams cad srab par 'dug pa dang*/ /rtsa ro dang ni sdong gcig dang*/ /bya rog rjes dang srin rjes dang*/ /ting (gting )khung dang ni dur sa dang*/ /shing lo ri mo med pa dang*//ri mo 'dzings nas 'dug pa dang*/ /yal ga thur du 'dug pa dang*//

phyi nang gnyis ka rtsub pa dang*/ /sob la yang bar 'dug pa dang*/ /bar gyi lha ba che ba dang*/ /rang sa'i dbus (u )zur med pa dang*/ /nor sar shong bu med pa dang | | dgra sar zur bu byung ba dang*/ /tshangs bug med dam mang ba dang*// bud med thod pa rigs ngan dang*/ /ngan pa tshang ba'i thod pa ste/ /mkhas pas chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab kha skong pod dang po/ mel po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 106PAGE 103
